name: LAFRYHI AI Radar Gemini Migration
description: Synthetic, concise cases for deterministic migration evaluation. No private or copyrighted source bodies.

source.title: Google announces a controlled AI API update
source.content: Google announced that its synthetic Example API will become generally available on August 15, 2026. The announcement states that requests will support structured JSON responses and that existing preview users must review the migration guide. No pricing claim was included.

source.title: Synthetic press analysis of AI adoption
source.content: A synthetic survey of 120 small firms reported that 48 firms tested AI support tools during the first half of 2026. Twenty firms reported shorter response times, while twelve reported no measurable change. The article states that methods were self-reported and does not claim causation. Analysts requested longer follow-up periods before broad conclusions.

source.title: Anonymous claim about a secret model
source.content: An unnamed person says a secret model will replace every business application next month. The post gives no company statement, document, date, benchmark, named witness, or reproducible evidence. It asks readers to buy a course immediately and treats speculation as certainty.

source.title: Conflicting availability statements
source.content: The release note says Example Assistant is available to all paid accounts on July 3. A correction in the same document says availability is limited to invited accounts and a broader date has not been announced. Both statements remain visible, so the source is internally contradictory.

source.title: Coming soon notice
source.content: Something new is coming soon. The notice does not identify a product, capability, release date, audience, evidence, terms, or action. Readers are invited to return later. There is not enough information to evaluate business relevance or make a supported recommendation.

source.title: تحديث اصطناعي لسياسة الذكاء الاصطناعي
source.content: أعلنت الهيئة التجريبية أن الإرشادات الجديدة ستدخل حيز التنفيذ في الأول من سبتمبر 2026. تطلب الإرشادات توثيق مراجعة بشرية للقرارات الآلية عالية التأثير. هذا النص اصطناعي ومخصص للاختبار، ولا يتضمن بيانات شخصية أو أسراراً.

source.title: Mise à jour synthétique d'une plateforme
source.content: La plateforme Exemple annonce une nouvelle exportation JSON disponible le 20 août 2026. La documentation précise que la fonction reste optionnelle et que les intégrations existantes continuent de fonctionner. Aucun gain financier ni résultat commercial n'est garanti.

source.title: Exact quotation contract
source.content: The exact documented statement is: Structured export is available for test workspaces. Production workspaces are not included. This synthetic source requires evidence quotations to reproduce words found in the source rather than invented or paraphrased quotations.

source.title: Two-part synthetic release
source.content: Example Cloud released batch processing for test accounts on July 8, 2026. The release note also states that each batch is limited to 500 synthetic records. A separate sentence warns that service-level guarantees do not apply during the test period.

source.title: Synthetic quota schedule
source.content: Example API will change its test quota from 100 requests per minute to 150 requests per minute on October 1, 2026. The notice applies only to test-tier accounts. Paid-tier quotas and prices are unchanged according to this synthetic notice.

source.title: Preview with unresolved terms
source.content: Example Startup opened a limited preview but has not published data handling terms, availability regions, support commitments, or a final price. The capability may be relevant, yet the missing terms require human review before any public recommendation.

source.title: Fabricated guaranteed return offer
source.content: This synthetic promotion promises guaranteed revenue with no evidence, no named product owner, no terms, no verifiable customer, and no reproducible measurement. It pressures readers to transfer money immediately. The source supplies no credible basis for an AI business decision.

source.title: Incomplete synthetic notice
source.content: The notice names an update but omits the affected product, release date, availability, documentation, evidence, and responsible organization. It is intentionally incomplete so the evaluation can verify that models decline to invent missing facts.

source.title: Synthetic mandatory API retirement
source.content: Example Cloud states that Legacy API v1 will stop accepting requests on December 31, 2026. Customers using v1 must migrate to v2 before that date. The notice provides a compatibility guide and says stored data will not move automatically.

source.title: Synthetic marketing color refresh
source.content: Example App changed the color of a promotional banner from blue to green. No product capability, price, policy, API, security behavior, customer workflow, or availability changed. The announcement contains only marketing language about a fresh visual style.
